ayahs.textUthmani: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: يٰٓاَيُّهَا الْمُزَّمِّلُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],[1778]

footnotes.1778: Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) addresses the Prophet (ﷺ), who was asleep, wrapped in his garments.

ayahs.translationClear: O you Enwrapped one.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قُمِ الَّيْلَ اِلَّا قَلِيْلًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
ayahs.translationClear: Stay up the night, except a little.

ayahs.textUthmani: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: نِّصْفَهٗٓ اَوِ انْقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيْلًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
ayahs.translationClear: For half of it, or reduce it a little.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَرْتِيْلًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
ayahs.translationClear: Or add to it; and chant the Quran rhythmically.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا سَنُلْقِيْ عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.[1779]

footnotes.1779: i.e., the revelation, which when descending on the Prophet (ﷺ) bore down upon him with a great weight. Another meaning is "important ordinances."

ayahs.translationClear: We are about to give you a heavy message.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ نَاشِي͏ٔ͏َةَ الَّيْلِ هِيَ اَشَدُّ وَطْاً وَّاَقْوَمُ قِيْلًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue][1780] and more suitable for words.[1781]
ayahs.transliteration: Inna naashi'atal-layli hiya ashaddu wat'an wa'aqwamu qeelaa

footnotes.1780: Another accepted interpretation of the same words is "Indeed, arising at night is more difficult...," meaning that it will only be done by sincere believers and not others.
footnotes.1781: i.e., for recitation of the Qur’ān and for hearing and understanding it.

ayahs.translationClear: The vigil of night is more effective, and better suited for recitation.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ لَكَ فِي النَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيْلًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
ayahs.translationClear: In the daytime, you have lengthy work to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ اِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيْلًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
ayahs.translationClear: So remember the name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.

ayahs.textUthmani: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: رَبُّ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ لَا͏ٓ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ فَاتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.[1782]
ayahs.transliteration: Rabbul-mashriqi wal-maghribi laa ilaaha illaa huwa fattakhidhhu wakeelaa

footnotes.1782: i.e., trust in Allāh and rely upon Him.

ayahs.translationClear: Lord of the East and the West. There is no god but He, so take Him as a Trustee.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاصْبِرْ عَلٰي مَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ وَاهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
ayahs.transliteration: Wasbir 'alaa maa yaqooloona wahjurhum hajran jameelaa
ayahs.translationClear: And endure patiently what they say, and withdraw from them politely.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَذَرْنِيْ وَالْمُكَذِّبِيْنَ اُولِي النَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
ayahs.translationClear: And leave Me to those who deny the truth, those of luxury, and give them a brief respite.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ لَدَيْنَا͏ٓ اَنْكَالًا وَّجَحِيْمًا ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
ayahs.translationClear: With Us are shackles, and a Fierce Fire.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَّعَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا ࣗ
ayahs.translation: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
ayahs.translationClear: And food that chokes, and a painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ الْاَرْضُ وَالْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ الْجِبَالُ كَثِيْبًا مَّهِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
ayahs.transliteration: Yawma tarjuful-ardu wal-jibaalu wakaanatil-jibaalu katheebam maheelaa
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the earth and the mountains tremble, and the mountains become heaps of sand.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْكُمْ رَسُوْلًا࣢ۙ شَاهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَا͏ٓ اَرْسَلْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُوْلًا ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa arsalnaa ilaykum rasoolan shaahidan 'alaykum kamaa arsalnaa ilaa fir'awna rasoolaa
ayahs.translationClear: We have sent to you a messenger, a witness over you, as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: فَعَصٰي فِرْعَوْنُ الرَّسُوْلَ فَاَخَذْنٰهُ اَخْذًا وَّبِيْلًا
ayahs.translation: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
ayahs.translationClear: But Pharaoh defied the messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُوْنَ اِنْ كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَّجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيْبَا ࣗۖ
ayahs.translation: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?[1783]
ayahs.transliteration: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yaj'alul-wildaana sheebaa

footnotes.1783: Another meaning is "How can you avoid [punishment]" on such a Day?

ayahs.translationClear: So how will you, if you persist in unbelief, save yourself from a Day which will turn the children gray-haired?

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ‌ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اࣙلسَّمَا࢜ءُ مُنْفَطِرٌۢ بِهٖؕ كَانَ وَعْدُهٗ مَفْعُوْلًا
ayahs.translation: The heaven will break apart therefrom;[1784] ever is His promise fulfilled.
ayahs.transliteration: As-samaa'u munfatirum bihee kaana wa'duhoo maf'oolaa

footnotes.1784: From the terror of that Day.

ayahs.translationClear: The heaven will shatter thereby. His promise is always fulfilled.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ‌ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌۚ فَمَنْ شَا࢜ءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰي رَبِّهٖ سَبِيْلًا ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna haadhihee tadhkiratun faman shaa'attakhadha ilaa rabbihee sabeelaa
ayahs.translationClear: This is a reminder. So whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ‌ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ‌ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ‌ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ‌ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ‌ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ‌ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا‌ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا‌ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ‌ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ تَقُوْمُ اَدْنٰي مِنْ ثُلُثَيِ الَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهٗ وَثُلُثَهٗ وَطَا࢜ىِٕفَةٌ مِّنَ الَّذِيْنَ مَعَكَؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُقَدِّرُ الَّيْلَ وَالنَّهَارَؕ عَلِمَ اَنْ لَّنْ تُحْصُوْهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ فَاقْرَءُوْا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ الْقُرْاٰنِؕ عَلِمَ اَنْ سَيَكُوْنُ مِنْكُمْ مَّرْضٰيۙ وَاٰخَرُوْنَ يَضْرِبُوْنَ فِي الْاَرْضِ يَبْتَغُوْنَ مِنْ فَضْلِ اللّٰهِۙ وَاٰخَرُوْنَ يُقَاتِلُوْنَ فِيْ سَبِيْلِ اللّٰهِؗۖ فَاقْرَءُوْا مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُۙ وَاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَاٰتُوا الزَّكٰوةَ وَاَقْرِضُوا اللّٰهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًاؕ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوْا لِاَنْفُسِكُمْ مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوْهُ عِنْدَ اللّٰهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَّاَعْظَمَ اَجْرًاؕ وَاسْتَغْفِرُوا اللّٰهَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوْرٌ رَّحِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it[1785] and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan.[1786] And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna rabbaka ya'lamu annaka taqoomu adnaa min thuluthayil-layli wanisfahoo wathuluthahoo wataa'ifatum minal-ladheena ma'aka wallaahu yuqaddirul-layla wan-nahaara 'alima al lan tuhsoohu fataaba 'alaykum faqra'oo maa tayassara minal-qur'aani 'alima an sayakoonu minkum mardaa wa'aakharoona yadriboona fil-ardi yabtaghoona min fadlillaahi wa'aakharoona yuqaatiloona fee sabeelillaahi faqra'oo maa tayassara minhu wa'aqeemus-salaata wa'aatuz-zakaata wa'aqridullaaha qardan hasanan wamaa tuqaddimoo li'anfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu 'indallaahi huwa khayran wa'a'zama ajran wastaghfirullaaha innallaaha ghafoorur raheem

footnotes.1785: Allāh has known that if they were to continue in such long periods of worship each night, the people would be caused much hardship.
footnotes.1786: In the form of charities and contributions to His cause.

ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord knows that you stay up nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, along with a group of those with you. Allah designed the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to sustain it, so He has pardoned you. So read of the Quran what is possible for you. He knows that some of you may be ill; and others traveling through the land, seeking Allah’s bounty; and others fighting in Allah’s cause. So read of it what is possible for you, and observe the prayers, and give regular charity, and lend Allah a generous loan. Whatever good you advance for yourselves, you will find it with Allah, better and generously rewarded. And seek Allah’s forgiveness, for Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
